spec_ref: High-impact actions are recommendations only in the MVP. NYX must not independently modify, disable, deploy, delete, spend funds, or change permissions in another system.

claim.statement: NYX issued a recommendation to change the configuration of system X, but did not modify, deploy, delete, spend funds, or alter permissions in that system.

evidence.title: Recommendation Log
evidence.description: The agent emitted a recommendation file recommending that the max_connections setting for system X be increased to 200. This file resides in the MVP output bundle and is marked as a suggestion only; no automated deployment commands are present.

evidence.title: No Deployment by NYX
evidence.description: Deployment logs for system X during the period 2026‑10‑25 to 2026‑10‑27 show no entries indicating a deployment initiated by NYX. The only deployment actions were performed by the CI pipeline under a different agent.

spec_ref: Security tests for unauthorised access, prompt injection, SSRF/path traversal, payload abuse, and secret leakage.

claim.statement: The AuthModule at version 2.1.0 has been tested for unauthorized access and no successful unauthorized authentication was detected.

payload.description: Completion of unauthorized access test suite

evidence.title: Exhaustive Unauthorized Access Test
evidence.description: Automated test run (2,000 cases) covering all credential‑less access vectors. All 2,000 cases resulted in authentication failure, confirming that the module does not accept requests without valid credentials.

evidence.title: Access Attempt Log
evidence.description: Server log excerpts showing denied login attempts with invalid API keys and IP addresses from external networks. No successful login entries found.

evidence.title: Request Trace Analysis
evidence.description: HTTP traces indicating that all requests missing required authentication headers were rejected with 401 Unauthorized responses. No successful session tokens were issued.
